title: 第8章 美女们“围攻”傻大壮
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
李大壮手上动作不停，同时冷声问张振生。

    “呵！一个傻子，还真惦记上我的副院长之位了！”张振生像是听到什么笑话似的，脸上的老褶都挤到了一起，大声嘲笑：“行！你要是真有这能耐，别说副院长了，我还愿意向你磕头拜师！”

    “这可是你说的！”李大壮似笑非笑的回头看了他一眼。

    不知道为啥，这傻子的一个眼神，竟让张振生莫名一慌！

    下一秒，他就听见了林晚禾倒抽气的声音：“缝，缝上了！真的缝上了！！”

    “什么！？不可能！！”

    张振生不敢置信的扑过去，果然看到李守义断掉的食指，竟然已经完好无损的回到了他的手上！

    更令他目瞪口呆的是，断指的连接处，竟然一点缝合的痕迹都没有，就好像这根手指从来没断过似的！

    “不！不可能！这根本不可能啊！”张振生狠狠的在自己脸上抽了两巴掌！

    疼！不是做梦！

    他见鬼了似的看着李大壮，李大壮却连个眼神都没给他，只是专心的继续缝合着下一根手指！

    倒是已经彻底惊呆的张桂芬和李秋霜，被张振生大耳刮子的声音给惊醒了，激动的浑身颤抖！

    “大壮真行！我儿子真行啊！这下可好了，不用去县医院花大钱，也能保住老头子的手指了！”

    “妈，大壮这回好了以后，本事更大了，以后你和我爸都可以放心了！”

    李大壮手指翻飞，又快又稳，没一会儿，就把父亲断掉的四根手指，全都接上了，而且全都没有缝合的痕迹，就和自己长上去似的，十分完美！

    “这，这简直太不可思议了！”林晚禾一直在近距离观察李大壮的动作，两团雪白贴在李大壮胳膊上，因为激动微微颤抖着，之前李大壮没心情感受，这会儿细细品味一下，其实两个圆润的触感不同，也是别有一番风味嘛！

Jiang Shuying also had the same desire. While quarreling with each other, she couldn't wait to pull Li Dazhuang and sit together on the spacious boss chair...

"Come on Da Zhuang~ No one will bother us this time~"

"You can...fuck me hard..."

"Hmm~"

Jiang Shuying gasped for invitation, and Li Dazhuang naturally wouldn't be polite to her!

"Hey, hey, hey~ Don't let me look around anymore, don't make me guess every day, you are my bride, I am your groom, come and get into our big bed~~~"

The familiar cell phone ringtone rang suddenly, which made Li Dazhuang and Jiang Shuying very angry!

"Why would someone bother me at the critical moment!?"

"Who knows? It seems like today is not the right time for us to do anything!"

"Don't we need to choose a good and auspicious day to have sex?" Jiang Shuying was about to collapse. She had lost weight for so many years to that damn ghost. Isn't it enough?

You have to torment people like this!?

"Sister-in-law, don't worry, I'll answer the phone first!"

Li Dazhuang took out his cell phone and saw that it was his mother calling. He must answer it quickly!

"Hey, Mom, what's wrong?"

"Da Zhuang, there is a man who brought some vicious people to our house. He said he wanted to do something with you. I asked them if they came to see you for medical treatment, but the man in charge changed his face on the spot and said that I am sick!" Zhang Guifen's angry voice came from the mobile phone!

"Your sister was so angry that she couldn't argue with them. They even scolded your sister. When Xiaomei heard the noise, she wanted to rush out. I was afraid that it would bite someone and cause trouble, so I asked your sister to stop it first!"

"They told you to come back quickly, otherwise they will destroy our house!!"

Li Dazhuang's expression was stern, but he still had some charming thoughts. He quickly put on his clothes with one hand and said urgently: "Mom, tell them, I will rush back immediately. If the other party dares to smash the yard, or use force against you and Sister Qiu Shuang, let Xiaomei bite them immediately. Don't be afraid of biting people to death. I can do anything!"

"Okay!" Zhang Guifen agreed, and then said to those people: "Don't mess around! My son will be back soon!"

"Okay! I'll give him half an hour. If I don't see him after half an hour, I guarantee that I will turn your poor yard into a garbage dump!"
